headline: Dow drops as health insurers slump
context: Health insurers sank on a Medicare audit plan, dragging the Dow down, while Nvidia slipped despite strong results and tech held up.

winners.name: Okta, Inc.
winners.why: No company news. Cybersecurity stocks rallied together, with Tenable and CrowdStrike also up.

winners.name: Palo Alto Networks
winners.why: No company news. It rose with other security stocks before its results came out after the close.

winners.name: Generac
winners.why: No company news. It bounced after a weak week, while its only S&P 500 peer, GE Vernova, slipped.

losers.name: Humana
losers.why: Fell for a second day after Medicare proposed wider audits of its private plans to claw back overpayments.

losers.name: UnitedHealth Group
losers.why: Sank with Humana as investors weighed the Medicare audit plan, a second straight day of steep falls for insurers.

losers.name: Elevance Health
losers.why: Dropped with Humana, UnitedHealth and Centene on the same Medicare audit proposal.

question: Is Medicare right to audit insurers harder, or is the sell-off overdone?
